items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: he had this guy Collins and his wife... Collins had complete power of attorney, and Louis didn't really understand what that was all about

ctx.x: -- and at this time the bus was terminating their service with us, and he was going to deadhead back to Chicago.

So we said no, we want our whole $40.00, man. We've been out on this road, man, working with Louis Armstrong? You've got to be kidding. Well he had this guy Collins and his wife, and Collins was an old law firm in Chicago, called Collins and Collins, and how Louis got situated with Collins and Collins was that when he got into this trouble out in California, on this reefer rap, it was sent to jail, he was working for Rockwell, Rockwell and O'Keefe, you know. He was working for Rockwell.
